items.message: @weight : {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℕ) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ
@index : {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → MvPolynomial σ ℝ → (σ → ℝ) → (σ → ℕ) → ℝ

@le_index_iff : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ},
      c ≤ index P α r ↔ ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) ≠ 0 → c ≤ weight r d

@hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {j : σ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
  {P : MvPolynomial σ R}, degreeOf j P < d j → (hasseDeriv d) P = 0
CUTOFF252_GENERAL_TYPE Roth.weight: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℕ) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ
CUTOFF252_GENERAL_TYPE Roth.index: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → MvPolynomial σ ℝ → (σ → ℝ) → (σ → ℕ) → ℝ

CUTOFF252_GENERAL_TYPE Cutoff252Project.generic_cutoff: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A]
  {P : MvPolynomial σ A},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (α : σ → A) (r : σ → ℕ) (T : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), Cutoff252Project.weightAny r d < c → d ∉ T → (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = 0) →
        (∀ d ∈ T, Cutoff252Project.weightAny r d < c → (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = 0) →
          c ≤ Cutoff252Project.indexAny P α r

CUTOFF252_GENERAL_TYPE Cutoff252Project.cutoff_local_degree: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), Roth.weight r d < c → (¬∀ (j : σ), d j ≤ r j) → ∃ (j : σ), degreeOf j P < d j) →
        (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (j : σ), d j ≤ r j) → Roth.weight r d < c → (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = 0) →
          c ≤ Roth.index P α r
